name: Marriott Bonvoy Bold® Credit Card

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services available as a basic benefit — provides referrals and coordination but does not cover costs.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver applies. Secondary coverage — file with personal auto insurance first. Must decline CDW at rental counter.

rewards.travelRate: 3x on purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy
rewards.diningRate: 2x on grocery stores, internet/cable/phone services, streaming services, rideshare, select food delivery

pointValue.transferPartners: 0.7–1.2¢ per point; best redeemed for Marriott stays (aim for 0.8¢+)

emergencyContacts.benefitsCenter: Visit chase.com or call the number on back of card

travelPerks: No annual fee — free to hold forever
14 Elite Night Credits annually toward Silver/Gold status
3x Marriott Bonvoy points on hotel stays
2x points on grocery stores, streaming, cable/internet/phone, rideshare, food delivery
Secondary rental car collision damage waiver
Points don't expire as long as card activity every 24 months
bestFor: Casual Marriott guests who want to earn hotel points with no annual fee — a starter card for building Marriott Bonvoy status without any cost
